protocol:
Real-data arm (INGV-UNISA and 4TU) of the detector-saturation experiment,
under docs/detector-saturation-experiment.md §7. BAM has its own script
(scripts/bam_detector_saturation.py) because it has object truth; these two
corpora do not.

* INGV-UNISA: the 50 content-unique lines (150 files, md5-deduplicated) of the
  2026-08-06 false-alarm baseline (production: 2,551 candidates, at the
  trace-permutation chance rate).
* 4TU: the file subset chosen by scripts/characterise_4tu_null.py's own
  rule (random.Random(20260807).sample of the sorted file list, 40 files),
  plus the activity-level comparison of benchmark.fourtu_scoring.

Detector configurations and thresholds are those frozen on synthetic
train+val (simulation/detector_freeze.json); the production ring is also run
at 3.0. Arm: mean-trace subtraction (the production path). For each line:
candidates (components >= min_cells), multi-trace candidates (>= 3 trace
columns), and the same count on N_DRAWS trace-order permutations of the raw
line (positions kept in place: the null destroys lateral structure only).

Inputs at inference are the traces, the sample interval, trace positions from
the SEG-Y headers (along-line distance; INGV source X/Y, 4TU group X), and a
frequency: 4TU's nominal 500 MHz; for INGV, whose antenna frequency is not in
the headers, the spectral peak of the line's own mean amplitude spectrum.

    python -m scripts.real_data_detector_saturation --corpus ingv --out artifacts/realdata/ingv.json
    python -m scripts.real_data_detector_saturation --corpus 4tu  --out artifacts/realdata/4tu.json

activity_level.activity_level_note: This is 'did the detector produce any candidate in an activity where the trench found a utility'. It is reported for completeness and carries almost no information on this corpus, because the detector produces candidates in essentially every activity -- including the trench-empty ones. A near-1.0 value here is not evidence of skill.

density_separation.interpretation: probability that a utility-bearing activity shows a higher candidate density than a trench-empty one; 0.5 is no separation

count_agreement.x: utilities found in the trial trench (declared_by_source)
count_agreement.interpretation: whether activities where the trench found more utilities also produce more detector candidates
count_agreement.caveat: a trench count is not a count of what lies under the survey lines; see trench_scope_caveat

activity_level.limitation: only 4 activities have an attested zero count, below the 10 needed before a rate is reported; the raw counts are given instead
activity_level.trench_scope_caveat: The count is what the TRIAL TRENCH found, and a trench is a small excavation inside a much larger surveyed area. A utility under a survey line but outside the trench is missing from the truth, not from the ground; a detector response there is not necessarily a false alarm.
activity_level.scope: 4TU results measure detector response on real-world utility surveys against trial-trench counts. They are activity-level only: no candidate is matched to a utility, and no positional or depth accuracy is measured.

provenance.truth_definition: The number of utilities found. Integer value.
